description: Type-check and test an existing connector (files you provide as {path, content}) in an isolated Nebius sandbox, with up to N repair attempts from the strong model. For TypeScript (default) the gate is tsc + vitest; for Python (lang: "py") it is compileall + pytest. Requires live keys (NEBIUS_API_KEY, NEBIUS_AI_PROJECT); returns the final test report and the (possibly repaired) files.

files.description: Connector files. For TS, include src/connector.ts + a *.test.ts; for Python, include connector.py + test_connector.py.

path.description: Relative path inside the connector (e.g. src/connector.ts)

lang.description: Target language the files are in. "ts" (default) or "py". If omitted, auto-detected from file extensions.

name: verify_code
title: Verify a connector
